work.title: Authored payer professional-normalization precondition fixture
authority: Direct user request to implement authored professional normalization proof fixtures, documentation, and feasible tests without creating professional approvals.

intent.productGoal: Make payer comparative evidence and its missing canonicalization/causation authority explicit without inferring a contract-rate normalization.
intent.capability: Provide a deterministic authored payer fixture with post-run truth assertions and testable ineligibility for professional approval.
architecturalIntent: Observed payer movement, payer identity authority, causal interpretation, and professional normalization remain separate objects.
Truth artifacts are excluded from intake.
Residuals remain explicit and are never silently allocated.
invariants: No professional approval record is authored.
No payer canonical identity or contract causation is inferred from raw labels or reference rates.
acceptanceEvidence: Post-run truth contract and proof semantics manifest.
Future canonicalization, decision API, and invalidation integration tests before any approval claim.

decisions.rationale: The repository has no payer canonicalization/crosswalk authority model or contract-causation decision contract.

observedBehaviour: Not yet executed as a browser/API proof; fixture-level assertions establish evidence-only payer movement and explicit authority blockers.

evidence.result: 30/30 tests passed, including PROF-NORM-PAYER-001 evidence-only raw-payer, zero-approval, and canonicalization-blocker assertions.
Authored fixture declares evidence-only payer movement, absent canonicalization authority, zero automatic normalization, and zero approval records.

divergences.expected: A future payer normalization decision is bound to a canonical payer and causal contract evidence.
divergences.observed: Payer labels remain raw/alias-mapped and a dedicated payer authority plus normalization API does not exist.

learning.recurringPattern: Comparative payer movement is not contract causation and cannot establish a normalization without identity and evidence authority.
learning.improvementProposal: Authorize and implement payer canonicalization/crosswalk semantics before enabling payer normalization decisions.
durableKnowledge: Raw payer labels cannot be silently normalized into canonical identities.
Reference rates remain context unless direct causal evidence and professional authority are recorded.
